source: Hermes user stories (website/src/data/userStories.json in the claude-code repo, MIT)
method: Distilled once by a model from the user stories; each seed links to the stories it came from.

seeds.title: Watch a sold-out showing and text you when seats open
seeds.what: Checks a sold-out event or showing on a schedule and messages you the moment seats in your range appear.

seeds.title: Book your gym classes the minute booking opens
seeds.what: Lists upcoming classes, asks you which you want, then books each one the instant booking opens.

seeds.title: Plan the week's meals and fill your grocery cart
seeds.what: Turns your saved recipes into a weekly meal plan scaled to your household and builds the pickup cart.

seeds.title: Suggest what to cook from what is in your pantry
seeds.what: Keeps a loose inventory from your chat messages and suggests dinners by what you have and what you cooked lately.

seeds.title: Keep school, tutor and home plans in sync for your child
seeds.what: Tracks tutoring sessions, school notes and home practice so you always see one current plan.

seeds.title: Draft client invoices from your tracked work
seeds.what: Reviews completed tasks and time entries, drafts the invoice and writes a short summary for the client.

seeds.title: Make quotes and invoices as PDFs for your jobs
seeds.what: Turns a short job description into a quote or invoice PDF and keeps a simple customer and job list.

seeds.title: Reconcile customer payments against your books
seeds.what: Matches incoming payments to invoices and ledger entries and lists what does not line up.

seeds.title: Send estimates, collect payment and keep books in sync
seeds.what: Drafts estimates for the owner's OK, sends them, collects payment and updates the accounting records.

seeds.title: Build a verified prospect list from one chat request
seeds.what: Takes a plain-language description of your target market and returns a list of contacts with verified details.

seeds.title: Research prospects and queue outreach for your approval
seeds.what: Finds and scores prospects, drafts personal messages and waits for your yes before anything goes out.

seeds.title: Draft a reply when a prospect responds
seeds.what: Spots replies to your outreach, summarizes the conversation and drafts the next message for you to approve.

seeds.title: Find and verify contact emails for outreach
seeds.what: Looks up and verifies business email addresses for the people on your target list.

seeds.title: Find local leads for a service business
seeds.what: Searches for homeowners or businesses likely to need your service and builds a lead list you can work.

seeds.title: Summarize new customer messages and ask how to reply
seeds.what: Reads new leads from your business inbox or page every few minutes, sums each up and asks how you want to answer.

seeds.title: Look up contacts, invoices and emails from team chat
seeds.what: Answers questions like who we last emailed or what a client owes by searching your CRM and billing from chat.

seeds.title: Answer phone calls from prospects using your proposal
seeds.what: Picks up calls on a business number, answers questions from your proposal and notes the outcome for you.

seeds.title: Run first-line IT support in your team chat
seeds.what: Answers staff IT questions from your guidelines, fixes routine issues and hands you only the ones that need a decision.

seeds.title: Post a narrated demo video of finished work for review
seeds.what: Builds a requested change, records a short walkthrough with a voiceover and posts it for your review.

seeds.title: Turn photos and spoken dimensions into a CAD drawing
seeds.what: Takes your photos and the key measurements you say aloud and produces a parametric drawing and model.

seeds.title: Split a project into tasks and have agents work them
seeds.what: Breaks a goal into tickets, assigns them to specialist agents and tracks progress on a shared board.

seeds.title: Check a job plan against your manuals and known issues
seeds.what: Runs a repair or work plan against product guides and advisories and flags steps that conflict with them.

seeds.title: Answer questions from long PDFs and manuals
seeds.what: Indexes large documents locally and answers questions with page references instead of loading everything.

seeds.title: Make workout and practice playlists every morning
seeds.what: Builds fresh playlists of the right length for your workout or practice session each day.

seeds.title: Check the weather each afternoon for your hobby plans
seeds.what: Checks the forecast daily and tells you which nights or days suit your hobby, such as stargazing.

seeds.title: Set up home safety alerts and a panic button for a relative
seeds.what: Wires door and motion sensors and a panic button into a simple local system that alerts family.

seeds.title: Keep your home network inventory current
seeds.what: Scans your network on a schedule and updates the device inventory and documentation.

seeds.title: Track card charges against your budget and answer questions
seeds.what: Reads your card charges, files them by category and tells you where you stand against your budget.

seeds.title: Watch your sensors and adjust devices overnight
seeds.what: Reads sensors on a regular cycle, compares them to your thresholds and switches devices or alerts you.

seeds.title: Flag problem service reports while the crew is still on site
seeds.what: Watches incoming field reports and flags missing or bad work in time to fix it before the crew leaves.

seeds.title: Draft deal memos and follow up on stale sales leads
seeds.what: Prepares production or sales paperwork and nudges you about leads that have gone quiet.

seeds.title: Turn rough dictation into structured documents
seeds.what: Takes voice notes or messy ideas sent from your phone and returns a clean, structured document.

seeds.title: Answer data questions from your company tools in team chat
seeds.what: Lets non-technical teammates ask about revenue, usage or ads and get answers pulled from your data tools.

seeds.title: Audit ad spend and suggest creative refreshes
seeds.what: Reviews ad performance, shows where money is wasted and proposes new creative variations.

seeds.title: Make the same change across hundreds of files and verify it
seeds.what: Applies a repeated edit across many files or rules, runs the tests and reports what changed.

seeds.title: Prepare a briefing before each client meeting
seeds.what: Researches the person and company, reads your notes on them and hands you a short prep brief.

seeds.title: Draft bids and legal documents from your company knowledge
seeds.what: Uses your past bids, contracts and standards to produce first drafts of new proposals and contracts.

seeds.title: Scan support tickets and turn patterns into fixes
seeds.what: Reviews new support tickets, groups the recurring problems and files tasks for the underlying cause.

seeds.title: Draft support replies using each customer's history
seeds.what: Pulls the customer's past conversations and orders and drafts a reply for you or the agent to send.

seeds.title: Review your pull requests and diffs before merge
seeds.what: Checks changes for bugs, leaked secrets, debug leftovers and unresolved TODOs and comments on them.

seeds.title: Write incident timelines and postmortems
seeds.what: Collects what happened during a production incident and writes the timeline and follow-ups.

seeds.title: Investigate production errors and open a fix for review
seeds.what: Wakes on bug spikes or user feedback, traces the cause and opens a pull request for you to approve.

seeds.title: Dictate quotes straight into your CRM
seeds.what: Turns a spoken or typed quote request into a CRM record and a ready-to-send quote.

seeds.title: Turn business client emails into store draft orders
seeds.what: Reads a client's order email and creates a draft order in your store for you to confirm.

seeds.title: Watch your stock levels and alert you when items run low
seeds.what: Checks inventory against thresholds and tells you what to reorder or bundle.

seeds.title: Triage your shop inbox for sales questions and orders
seeds.what: Scans your business email and separates sales, customer questions and noise for you.

seeds.title: Answer questions about orders and inventory from your phone
seeds.what: Lets you ask in chat about pending orders, stock and past prices and get answers from your business tools.

seeds.title: Review search performance and propose content to publish
seeds.what: Checks your analytics and search data each day, finds opportunities and drafts content for your approval.

seeds.title: Watch competitor pages and keywords weekly
seeds.what: Scans competitor sites on a schedule and tells you how their pages and keywords compare with yours.

seeds.title: Watch competitor pricing and alert on changes
seeds.what: Checks competitor sites, pricing and news on a schedule and sends you a short digest of what changed.

seeds.title: Audit your store's product pages for search
seeds.what: Reviews product and collection pages for search problems and lists fixes in priority order.

seeds.title: Run a daily standup in your team chat
seeds.what: Asks the team for updates each morning, tracks goal numbers and posts a summary.

seeds.title: Ask your top priority each morning and plan tasks around it
seeds.what: Asks what matters most today, lines up the tasks that support it and remembers how you work.

seeds.title: Spot tasks you repeat by hand and suggest automating them
seeds.what: Notices work you keep doing manually and proposes how to automate it.

seeds.title: Send a daily briefing on the topics you follow
seeds.what: Searches the web each morning for news on your interests and messages you a filtered summary.

seeds.title: Email you a daily digest of what you should read
seeds.what: Reads sites like Hacker News or RSS feeds once a day and emails you what deserves your attention.

seeds.title: Summarize your inbox each weekday and post it to team chat
seeds.what: Reads your inbox at a set time and posts a short summary to a channel you pick.

seeds.title: Triage your inbox and text you what is urgent
seeds.what: Watches your email, uses the AI only on mail that matters and messages you the urgent items.

seeds.title: Draft email replies and keep security codes out of reach
seeds.what: Drafts replies to ordinary mail but filters out login codes, password resets and bank notices first.

seeds.title: Scout new rental listings each morning and email the best
seeds.what: Reads daily listing alerts and sends you the one to three best matches for your criteria.

seeds.title: Keep your tasks in sync with your notes and calendar
seeds.what: Maintains your task list in your notes and cross-checks it against your calendar.

seeds.title: Keep your calendar updated and catch conflicts
seeds.what: Adds events from your email and chats to your calendar and warns you about clashes.

seeds.title: Fill out online forms for you
seeds.what: Opens a website in a real browser, fills in a form with details you provide and stops before submitting for your check.

seeds.title: Log your day into your notes and summarize it each night
seeds.what: Records what you tell it about your day in your notes and writes a short evening summary.

seeds.title: Review the day's chats each night and log decisions
seeds.what: Reads the day's conversations, extracts decisions and open items and writes tomorrow's plan.

seeds.title: Write bedtime stories starring your child
seeds.what: Writes a fresh short story each night with your child's name and favorite characters.

seeds.title: Set up a safe learning assistant for your child
seeds.what: Creates a separate assistant for a child with age-appropriate rules and a parent approval step.

seeds.title: Track workouts and health data and spot trends
seeds.what: Collects what you log and your wearable data, then tells you what the numbers mean over time.

seeds.title: Plan a trip using the preferences you have mentioned before
seeds.what: Recalls what you liked on past trips and builds a new itinerary around it.

seeds.title: Build a personal wiki from what you read and discuss
seeds.what: Files your notes, articles and chats into a linked wiki that you can search and that stays tidy.

seeds.title: Turn your SOPs and client notes into a company brain
seeds.what: Gathers your procedures and decisions into one searchable base your team can ask questions of.

seeds.title: File forwarded email threads into your company wiki
seeds.what: Watches a shared mailbox and adds the lasting facts from forwarded threads to your wiki.

seeds.title: Deliver a daily research brief on your field
seeds.what: Watches sources in your field, picks the useful signals and writes a short brief with content ideas.

seeds.title: Rank your saved bookmarks and suggest next steps
seeds.what: Picks your most relevant saved posts, ranks them by your interests and proposes what to do about each.

seeds.title: Turn your saved posts into a listenable podcast
seeds.what: Pulls posts from your lists and bookmarks, structures them and generates an audio episode.

seeds.title: Turn podcasts into short digests
seeds.what: Transcribes the podcasts you follow and gives you a brief digest of each episode.

seeds.title: Translate and summarize long pages and documents
seeds.what: Translates and condenses articles and documents so you can read them in your own language.

seeds.title: Research a topic and save a reference sheet
seeds.what: Looks up a topic, organizes the answers in a table and saves it in your notes for next time.

seeds.title: Draft posts in your own voice for your approval
seeds.what: Reads what you have published, then writes social posts that sound like you and waits for your yes.

seeds.title: Make short-form video slideshows from a topic
seeds.what: Researches a topic, writes the script and builds slides in the right dimensions for short-form video.

seeds.title: Generate product ad concepts from a product page
seeds.what: Reads a product page, finds winning hooks in your niche and generates draft ad creatives.

seeds.title: Research weekly video ideas and draft titles
seeds.what: Finds what is trending in your area each week and drafts video topics and titles.

seeds.title: Pull performance stats for your social posts
seeds.what: Collects analytics for your recent posts and tells you what worked.

seeds.title: Turn meeting notes into tasks
seeds.what: Reads your meeting notes and files the action items with owners and dates in your task tracker.

seeds.title: Draft follow-up emails after your meetings
seeds.what: Uses the meeting transcript to draft follow-up emails to attendees for your approval.

seeds.title: Summarize your portfolio news each morning
seeds.what: Collects news and price moves on the holdings you name and sends a short morning summary.

seeds.title: Alert you to unusual moves in prediction markets
seeds.what: Watches market categories you choose, researches the likely reason for big moves and sends a brief without trading.

seeds.title: Watch your crypto balances and alert on big moves
seeds.what: Checks your wallet balances and prices on a schedule and messages you when something moves past your threshold.

seeds.title: Watch your node endpoints and ping you when they go down
seeds.what: Checks validator or server endpoints on a schedule and messages you when one stops responding.

seeds.title: Watch prices for movies or products and alert on lows
seeds.what: Checks the prices of items on your list and tells you when one hits a new low.

seeds.title: Nudge you through routines with timed reminders
seeds.what: Sends timed prompts on your phone so routines happen without you having to start them.

seeds.title: Collect daily signals and send a triaged summary
seeds.what: Runs small checks through the day, logs the results and sends one ranked summary of what needs you.

seeds.title: Boil down busy group chats into a short summary
seeds.what: Reads active group chats and sends you the few lines that matter, such as safety updates or schedule changes.

seeds.title: Draft replies to customer messages and ask before sending
seeds.what: Drafts answers to customer chats in your voice and runs jobs only after you approve in your chat app.

seeds.title: Run a chief-of-staff that tracks each project's open items
seeds.what: Keeps a running list of open items and decisions per project and reports what is stuck.

seeds.title: Send clients a daily status with pull requests and builds
seeds.what: Collects pull request notices, build status and progress and sends each client a short update.

seeds.title: Triage new tickets, assign them and start working
seeds.what: Reads new tickets in your tracker, prioritizes and assigns them and begins on the straightforward ones.

seeds.title: Turn a request or spec into a reviewed pull request
seeds.what: Takes a written spec or forwarded document, makes the change in your repo and opens a pull request.

seeds.title: Build a small useful tool for you every night
seeds.what: Each night builds a small app or script aimed at your goals and tells you what it made.

seeds.title: Build and deploy a landing page from a short brief
seeds.what: Researches you or your business, builds a landing page and publishes it to your server.

seeds.title: Have one agent audit another's code overnight
seeds.what: Runs a second model over code written by the first and reports the problems it finds by morning.

seeds.title: Build a dashboard from your data
seeds.what: Turns a spreadsheet or database into a clean dashboard you can open in a browser.

seeds.title: Set up a simple CRM for your contacts
seeds.what: Creates a lightweight contact database with a dashboard and keeps it updated from your conversations.

seeds.title: Back up your agent's settings to a repo each night
seeds.what: Commits your agent's configuration and data to a private repository nightly so you can restore it.

seeds.title: Check on your servers and fix routine problems
seeds.what: Checks disk, services and containers on your server and fixes the routine issues or reports them.

seeds.title: Set up uptime and metrics alerts for your service
seeds.what: Sets up metrics collection and alert rules for your service and checks that they fire.

seeds.title: Act automatically when a file changes in a folder
seeds.what: Watches a folder and runs the steps you describe whenever a file appears or changes.

seeds.title: Write clean commit messages that follow your convention
seeds.what: Writes commit messages in your team's format with a short subject and a body explaining why.

seeds.title: Learn your codebase conventions and apply them in reviews
seeds.what: Builds up knowledge of your repo, deployment quirks and preferences so reviews and changes match your style.

seeds.title: Watch another bot or process and restart it when it breaks
seeds.what: Checks that your other agents and jobs are running and restarts or reports the ones that fail.

seeds.title: Keep a log of everything installed on your machine
seeds.what: Records the packages and containers your tools install so you know where they came from.

seeds.title: Draft a weekly marketing performance report
seeds.what: Pulls your marketing, support and traffic numbers each week and writes a short report of what changed.

seeds.title: Check your bank and payment balances every morning
seeds.what: Reads balances and recent activity from your bank and payment accounts and flags anything unusual.

seeds.title: Draft your newsletter from what you published
seeds.what: Collects your recent content and writes a newsletter draft for your approval before it is sent.

seeds.title: Create and edit slide decks
seeds.what: Builds or edits a presentation from your outline and existing documents.

seeds.title: Talk to your assistant by voice instead of typing
seeds.what: Lets you speak your requests and hear the answers, useful when typing is hard or your hands are busy.

seeds.title: Turn a concept into an explainer video
seeds.what: Takes a topic or paper and produces a short animated explainer video.

seeds.title: Build web pages that match your own style guide
seeds.what: Turns your preferred design style into rules so every page the agent builds looks consistent.

seeds.title: Answer staff and customer questions for your shop in chat
seeds.what: Runs an internal channel for staff questions about inventory and policies, with a separate customer-facing helper.

seeds.title: Keep separate assistants for work, family and hobbies
seeds.what: Sets up separate assistants for work, coaching and home so context and permissions do not mix.

seeds.title: Draft a client deliverable from your SOPs
seeds.what: Follows your checklist to produce a repeatable deliverable for each client with a separate workspace per client.

seeds.title: Remember your preferences so you stop repeating them
seeds.what: Saves your preferences and tool quirks once and applies them in every later conversation.

seeds.title: Give your agent its own email inbox to work from
seeds.what: Creates a dedicated mailbox where alerts and forwarded mail land so the agent never touches your main inbox.

seeds.title: Read your calendar and Gmail together to plan your day
seeds.what: Combines your email and calendar each morning into a short plan with what needs attention.

seeds.title: Run a weekly review of your goals and notes
seeds.what: Reads your notes and logs each week and writes a review of what moved and what stalled.

seeds.title: Keep a shared company agent that remembers months of context
seeds.what: Carries long-term company knowledge between team agents so new tasks start with full context.

seeds.title: Route approvals to the right person in your chat app
seeds.what: Sends high-stakes actions to an approver on their phone and only proceeds after a yes.

seeds.title: Summarize new customer requests and file them as tasks
seeds.what: Turns customer emails and chats into tasks with the details attached.
